description:
Derive each issue record path from a typed `IssueId` through one infallible `VirtualPath` constructor, in storage and repository-state code.

## Background

The record path `issues/{id}.json` is spelled at 33 production lines in 15 files. Four private helpers build it: `repository_state/mutation.rs:503`, `repository_state/archive.rs:426`, `storage/memory.rs:338-339` and `storage/json.rs:730-731`, which joins the id under `issues/` on the host filesystem. Further host spellings sit at `storage/json.rs:904,940`, and `repository_state/materialize.rs` spells the path once. `VirtualPath` (`repository_state/path.rs:200`) offers `worktree` (`:330`) and `data` (`:337`) constructors. Only its identity module (`path.rs:191-319`) can build a descendant without a fallible check, and host paths derive through `RepositoryLayout::resolve` (`path.rs:530`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `VirtualPath::issue_record(&IssueId)` is infallible and returns the data-root path of that issue's record.
- [hard] REQ-02: The four private issue-path helpers are gone. Both storage backends and repository-state code derive issue record paths from the constructor, and host paths from `RepositoryLayout::resolve`.
- [hard] REQ-03: No `format!` under `crates/jit/src/storage/` or `crates/jit/src/repository_state/` spells an issue record path or record file name.
- [hard] REQ-04: No `expect` remains on the memory backend's record path.
title: Issue record paths come from a VirtualPath constructor
